document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The pounding hooves give you no option for teamwork. You 
hear an anguished cry of “Professor!” and throw a glance back at 
Sylvia. She has fallen way behind. There is nothing you can do. 
In an instant, she is bowled over by a woolly rhinoceros. Her 
body is tossed in the air and goes under. Stunned, but operating 
on instinct, you and Norman reach the low-hanging limbs of 
the wood’s edge and clamber up.

The  bleating  horde  rushes  harmlessly  below  you.  By  the 
time you climb down, the two of you are too heartsick to do 
anything but set your feet for home.
